entradas.text: "Well... I actually have to say this too. I am really surprised that the proposal is abolishing the member of honor title. I support that part."
She took a sip from her glass.
"Sure, we just need to have *blind faith*."
"If we were to come back to the point of unifying against the Old Guard..."
"I want the Old Guard gone as much as you, but I am torn about this proposal."
"Why?"
entradas.menu: "Why?"

entradas.text: Nia suddenly cut in.
"The Court protects the Constitution. I would have done the same with my proposal today."
entradas.menu: "The Court protects the Constitution. I would have done the same with my proposal today."

entradas.text: She took a sip from her glass.
"Well... I actually have to say this. I am really surprised that you are bringing term limits. That's one good point of the proposal."
"I don't agree with that. I am no Malenyevist."
entradas.menu: "I don't agree with that. I am no Malenyevist."

entradas.text: She took a sip from her glass.
"Purely an advisory body for legislation and the high criminal court."
entradas.menu: "Purely an advisory body for legislation and the high criminal court."

entradas.text: "Well... At least you are bringing term limits. I guess that's one positive aspect."
"It must have the power of judicial review and to strike down laws that are against the Constitution."
entradas.menu: "It must have the power of judicial review and to strike down laws that are against the Constitution."

entradas.text: "Tell me... Are you planning to put Soll to trial?"
"You are playing with fire, Mr. President."
"No. Even though I'm abolishing his position, he must be respected as the founder of our second republic."
entradas.menu: "No. Even though I'm abolishing his position, he must be respected as the founder of our second republic."

entradas.text: "I have no such plans. The important thing here is now he will be a regular Sordish citizen."
entradas.menu: "I have no such plans. The important thing here is now he will be a regular Sordish citizen."

entradas.text: "Yes. He should be properly investigated and finally answer for his crimes."
entradas.menu: "Yes. He should be properly investigated and finally answer for his crimes."

entradas.text: "The threshold not only affects them but all of us. It can lead to a political crisis in the future."
entradas.menu: "The threshold not only affects them but all of us. It can lead to a political crisis in the future."

entradas.text: "I am a democratic socialist, Mrs. Edmonds. There is a difference."
entradas.menu: "I am a democratic socialist, Mrs. Edmonds. There is a difference."

entradas.text: "I don't agree with their ideologies, but we must be fair."
entradas.menu: "I don't agree with their ideologies, but we must be fair."

entradas.text: "I don't want to hand a victory to a Malenyevist."
"Anyway... At least the proposal introduces term limits. I can say that I support that point."
"These changes are one thing. But there is also your political view..."
"I see."
"We can't silence different political opinions anymore, Mrs. Edmonds."
entradas.menu: "We can't silence different political opinions anymore, Mrs. Edmonds."

entradas.text: "I also like that the proposal introduces term limits. That's another good point."
"You must understand that it is the way forward."
entradas.menu: "You must understand that it is the way forward."

entradas.text: "So what do you think about the judicial review?"
"I didn't say that. But if we're not careful, we will become a puppet, Mr. President."
She took a sip from her glass.
"I don't agree with that. We are not their puppet."
entradas.menu: "I don't agree with that. We are not their puppet."

entradas.text: "I want to help you, Mrs. Morgna. But..."
"Anyway, I don't have much else to say."
"So, Mrs. Edmonds... What are you thinking?"
"Anyway, I don't have much else to say."
"It gives the Court an abrupt power over other branches."
entradas.menu: "It gives the Court an abrupt power over other branches."

entradas.text: "Why are you asking me these questions?"
entradas.menu: "Why are you asking me these questions?"

entradas.text: "These changes are one thing. But you also lead an alarming narrative..."
"Right..."
"Yes... Sordland definitely gives presidents paranoia."
"It plays an essential role in ensuring that each branch of government recognizes the limits of its own power."
entradas.menu: "It plays an essential role in ensuring that each branch of government recognizes the limits of its own power."

entradas.text: "I am concerned about your heavy pursuit of capitalism. You are bringing Arcasia's influence to Sordland."
She coughed.
"Weren't you for Alphonso's free market reforms? Why are you suddenly against this?"
entradas.menu: "Weren't you for Alphonso's free market reforms? Why are you suddenly against this?"

entradas.text: "I have to protect myself after my duty ends too. Sordland is dangerous for presidents."
entradas.menu: "I have to protect myself after my duty ends too. Sordland is dangerous for presidents."

entradas.text: "I disagree. Soll wasn't any trouble after he resigned. I think we deserve this title."
entradas.menu: "I disagree. Soll wasn't any trouble after he resigned. I think we deserve this title."

entradas.text: "Mrs. Edmonds. You are exaggerating it. It's only a symbolic title."
entradas.menu: "Mrs. Edmonds. You are exaggerating it. It's only a symbolic title."

entradas.text: "We need Arcasia's support as a country. They can be an important ally."
entradas.menu: "We need Arcasia's support as a country. They can be an important ally."

entradas.text: "...I still have great concerns about the Assembly. You are giving them too much power. How can we ensure that they will never go rogue in the future?"
"The only one who wins here is you, Mr. President. What are you trying to do?"
"Wasn't that even a concern for you?"
"And what about the Assembly? You are giving them too much power. How can we ensure that they will never go rogue in the future?"
"I find the growing Arcasian influence concerning. I supported the free market reforms earlier but you can't afford to be reckless like Alphonso."
"What do you mean why? I asked you a question."
"...If I give you the power to impeach us today... What's going to happen tomorrow? Can you even give me any guarantees that this will not result in the destruction of the Court?"
"The President is elected by people and the title should not be taken away by anyone else."
entradas.menu: "The President is elected by people and the title should not be taken away by anyone else."

entradas.text: "There are still checks and balances. They can't go against the Constitution."
entradas.menu: "There are still checks and balances. They can't go against the Constitution."

entradas.text: "Of course it was a concern. But this is a transition. The future lies in the parliamentary system."
entradas.menu: "Of course it was a concern. But this is a transition. The future lies in the parliamentary system."

entradas.text: "No it's not. We have to believe in the MP's. The Assembly is our most democratic branch."
entradas.menu: "No it's not. We have to believe in the MP's. The Assembly is our most democratic branch."

entradas.text: "This will also be a huge burden on the government to take care of every former President's lavish lifestyles..."
"Don't be. We are together in this. This will open the way for further reforms too."
entradas.menu: "Don't be. We are together in this. This will open the way for further reforms too."

entradas.text: "But what about giving yourself the Member of Honor title too? You are clearly playing a dangerous game here, Mr. President. We don't want another king."
"This will also be a huge burden on the government to take care of every former President's lavish lifestyles..."
"I don't agree."
"Even a president who becomes another Tarquin Soll? Would you be okay if people elected a Malenyev here?"
"I tried to stop it. But the Chief Justice was the puppet master. Alphonso didn't deserve that."
"As I said before, it is only a safety mechanism for threats like the Old Guard."
entradas.menu: "As I said before, it is only a safety mechanism for threats like the Old Guard."

entradas.text: "...I still have great concerns about making every president a member of honor. That title was created for Soll to protect himself. Not only dangerous..."
"Mr. President. I am also wondering... If you were in Soll's position, how would you have structured the Supreme Court? What do you even believe is its role?"
"...I still have great concerns about making every president a member of honor. That title was created for Soll to protect himself. Not only dangerous..."
"Vote yes. There is not much to think."
entradas.menu: "Vote yes. There is not much to think."

entradas.text: "And how about you? You are giving yourself total immunity... The only one who wins here is you, Mr. President. What are you trying to do?"
"Please, Mrs. Edmonds. We need your help."
entradas.menu: "Please, Mrs. Edmonds. We need your help."

entradas.text: "Let's just forget it and enjoy our meal."
She looked at me.
"You know Sordish politics, Mrs. Edmonds. We have to protect the presidents. Remember Alphonso?"
entradas.menu: "You know Sordish politics, Mrs. Edmonds. We have to protect the presidents. Remember Alphonso?"

entradas.text: "Precisely."
"I had to protect myself from all the backlash from changing Soll's Constitution."
entradas.menu: "I had to protect myself from all the backlash from changing Soll's Constitution."

entradas.text: "You have nothing to worry about. The Justices cannot be impeached so easily."
entradas.menu: "You have nothing to worry about. The Justices cannot be impeached so easily."

entradas.text: "...I still have great concerns. This proposal would pave the way for the WPB and the CPS to enter the Assembly... I don't want to be a supporter of that."
"You are an interesting man indeed, Mr. President."
"I promise, Mrs. Edmonds. Centrists will have nothing to worry about. You have my word."
entradas.menu: "I promise, Mrs. Edmonds. Centrists will have nothing to worry about. You have my word."

entradas.text: "Let's just forget it and enjoy the remaining of our meal."
Isabel went on to finish the remaining of her salad.
"I'm glad that we agree on that."
"...I still have great concerns about the removal of the President's impeachment procedure. The President is giving himself total immunity here..."
"So you'd rather have no Court, no balances or checks in our goverment..."
"I don't think that's what he meant, Mrs. Edmonds."
"Fine. I am not asking any more questions."
"Malenyev isn't the only communist theoretician, Mrs. Edmonds."
entradas.menu: "Malenyev isn't the only communist theoretician, Mrs. Edmonds."

entradas.text: "So what? You're going to tell me you pursue Marco-Raynism or something?"
"So what? You're going to tell me you pursue Valgslandian Socialism or something?"
"So, you're no fan of Malenyev? Who cares if you're into Chancellor Hegel's Valgslandian Socialism, or Sordish socialism of Bernard Circas? It's all Karlos Marcia's socio-economics in the end..."
"Who cares if you're into Chancellor Hegel's socialism, or Sordish socialism of Bernard Circas? It's all Karlos Marcia's socio-economics in the end..."
She let out a sigh.
"Anyway... There's no point in discussing this with you at this moment."
